item.title: NVVN Issues 4-Hr BESS Tender for 500 MWh / 125 MW in Chhattisgarh
item.description: NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam (NVVN) has recently issued a 500 MWh / 125 MW standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tender offering four hours of on-demand power in Chhattisgarh. NVVN has issued the BESS tender in partnership with the Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited (CSPTCL) and has sought bids for the project til December 30, 2025. item.title: SJVN Issues 250 MW/500 MWh BESS Tender At 1.36 GW Panipat Thermal Power Station
item.description: SJVN has recently issued a tender for a 250 MW/500 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) in Haryana. The total project capacity of 250 MW/500 MWh would be located in the vicinity of the 220 kV substation of the STU network, under Haryana Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited (HVPNL). The project would be placed at the 1,360 MW Panipat Thermal Power Station (PTPS) premises in Haryana. It has sought bids for the tender until January 6, 2026. item.title: J.K. Cement Invests ₹5.10 Cr in O2 Renewable SPV for Karnataka Wind Project
item.description: J.K. Cement continues to push for a higher share of renewable energy in its operations. It has made an additional investment in O2 Renewable Energy V Private Limited (SPV), increasing its equity shareholding by 12.21%, acquired from JSW Neo Energy Limited. In a regulatory filing, the company said it has expanded its investment by ₹5 crore 10 lakh, raising its overall stake in the SPV from 16.76% to 28.97%.
